wilds.name: Wild
wilds.behavior: The wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except the Laser, Wild Forge, Charged Wild, multiplier wild and bonus symbols.

wilds.name: Charged Wild
wilds.behavior: The Charged Wild symbol has 4 extra lives. It spends a life when it contributes to a win, and becomes a regular wild when it spends its fourth life.
